Code-to-Video: pure-code video, delivery

Every frame in these videos is a pure function of time, painted by scene code (p5.js + p5.brush watercolour, GLSL style shaders) and rendered in headless Chrome. Sound is either the input song or synthesised from a code score. No video or image generation model is used anywhere. Each case below links its storyboard, code-level checks, review record, render log and metrics.

Where things were verified: all renders here ran on a GPU-less Linux VM (SwiftShader). Brush cases were rendered at preview scale 0.5. Final scale-1 GPU renders on the Mac are open items (commands below). Status words: verified = reproduced with recorded evidence; pending = not yet run.

Across 12 pieces, review passes caught 68 problems in 37 passes. Grouped by type:

failure typewhere it was caughtfed back into
key idea / event not readable at sheet scale (prop too small, flat, hidden, cropped)first-pass sheetsc2v-review worked examples; c2v-storyboard "one EVENT" check
continuity: props popping in/out, position jumps, double takes across cutsseam stripsc2v-review; c2v-build pattern "start B with A's last key"
camera works against the read (pull-back reads as shrinking, near-identical framings = jump cut, payoff out of frame)fixed-step sheetsc2v-review
contact / draw order (hand not touching, character in front of what it pushes)cropsc2v-build failures table
timing: reaction on top of cause, effect before cause, stroke off the beatfixed-step sheets + constantsc2v-build "one constant per event"
style destroys detail (stained glass, small props)style sheetsstained/pixel size parameter; storyboard swaps actions between styles
tooling (check crash on load error, encode ignored song, CJK font, lyric time mistake)runsfixed in lib/ + tests/run.mjs

ALL PASS

Open items

  • Final scale-1 GPU renders on the Mac: node bin/c2v.mjs render <project> --workers=4 for umbrella, pdoom-c08, upgrade, whale (bench is already scale 1).
  • Case A was not a blind test (the chapter summary had been read); rerun on an unseen chapter with a fresh agent.
  • Case B: ingest the real meme image and compare against the original 42 s video when the Feishu attachments are available.
  • The subtitle detector false-positives on halftone/pixel textures; the pixel cut detector misses motion-continuous transitions. Both are documented in c2v-deliver.
  • Visual density: the regenerated chorus (A) and the upgrade chorus (C) have plainer sets than their references; the pipeline gets the structure right, set design needs more passes.
